title: AC1021 fixed nonprocedural MATERIAL body parsing
scope: Decode the bounded fixed nonprocedural MATERIAL body profile for AC1021, preserving same-version raw capture and refusing semantic publication when the body, string stream, or zero-padding bounds do not match. This does not qualify DXF output or native material behavior.

authority.format: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 remains authoritative for shared DWG framing and bit encodings; it does not publish a MATERIAL body schema.
authority.bodySchema: The fixed nonprocedural field order follows LibreDWG dwg2.spec and is corroborated by the source-bound AC1021 peer audit and local physical-source probe. Procedural and unknown tails remain unsupported.

source.provenanceLimit: Existing local DWG; its producer and author are not independently authenticated. No fixture was added to the repository.
source.materialGraph: One ACAD_MATERIAL dictionary at 0x6A with ByBlock 0xED, ByLayer 0xEC, and Global 0xEE; each material has the dictionary as owner and its sole reactor.

independentPeer.result: The peer JSON exposes all three material records, the same handles and owner/reactor graph, and fixed body fields including color methods/factors, six map profiles, channel flags and illumination values. The local probe checks the shared scalar/map profile and graph roles.

implementation.change: Apply the existing independently-cursored fixed nonprocedural body decoder to AC1021 in addition to its AC1024/AC1027 profiles. Exact bounded consumption remains required before semantic fields are published; existing raw payload capture is unchanged.
implementation.generatedRegression: The default-material graph control now requires semantic field publication for locally generated AC1021 material records while retaining AC1021 raw-payload checks.

validation.physicalProbeResult: passed: all three source materials publish complete semantic profiles; the tested graph and scalar/map fields match the peer-observed profile.
validation.sourceRead: The current dwg2dxf build publishes 1,673/1,673 observed frames and reports zero entity/object parse failures on this source. Whole-source output still refuses at the independent DBCOLOR source-profile gate; no DXF is emitted.

limits: No physical MATERIAL graph output or fresh DXF readback is qualified.
Procedural materials, unknown fields/tails, other producer profiles, native material rendering, and whole-drawing interoperability remain open.
The AC1021 default-material graph remains explicit opt-in; this parser change does not broaden writer admission or support claims.
